cues: Without a net force, nothing changes.
With one, the acceleration is the force divided by the mass.
And forces come in equal and opposite pairs, acting on different bodies.
For constant acceleration, three equations connect velocity, distance and time.
text: Newton's three laws. Without a net force, nothing changes. With one, the acceleration is the force divided by the mass. And forces come in equal and opposite pairs, acting on different bodies. For constant acceleration, three equations connect velocity, distance and time.
